summary: Per-unit shortfall penalty vs min_stop_load (per dimension).
range: Array of integers, one per capacity dimension.
constraints: Same dimension count as min_stop_load / capacity.
businessRules: Scales with how far below min_stop_load a delivery falls.

min_stop_load_unit_penalty defines: Defines the penalty applied per unit of load shortfall when a task’s load is lower than the vehicle’s configured min_stop_load. As a result, higher penalty values make the optimizer increasingly re…
Each element in min_stop_load_unit_penalty must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.min_stop_load. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
This is a soft constraint. Violations are penalized but don't make solutions infeasible.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Behavioral: larger shortfall -> proportionally larger penalty.
